objective: Execute the seven-day correctness-to-evidence plan in one gated day without bypassing scientific validity gates.

time_compute_cap.confirmatory_rule: Only a bounded scripted-policy evidence round whose seed budget is justified by the pilot; no HPC and no learned-policy training.

dependency_gates: Continuous within-step contact and event-keyed ties pass deterministic microcases.
Matched null/signal wrapper proves identical initialization, Brownian tensor, nuisance variables, policy-randomness provenance, and tie provenance.
Trajectory instances validate against schemas and carry input/output checksums.
local_flow_v1 and mandatory scripted controls are frozen before the pilot.
Estimator calibration and bootstrap reproducibility pass before evidence interpretation.

frozen_primary.inference: seed-clustered paired bootstrap with one-sided simultaneous 95% lower bounds across nonzero grid points
frozen_primary.boundary: smallest preregistered rho with strictly positive simultaneous lower bound; otherwise report censoring

kill_conditions: Any correctness or pairing gate fails after bounded repair.
The centralized oracle fails to improve over null across the tested grid.
The local_flow_v1 result is explained by stationary, random, coverage, or density controls.
The seed budget required for useful precision exceeds the bounded CPU budget.
The work cannot isolate a multi-agent mechanism and remains only sports-free single-agent prediction or collection.
deliverables: immutable raw pilot/evidence outputs and checksums
deduplicated research and industry expansion entries
fallback: If an upstream gate fails, spend the remaining run repairing and documenting that blocker; do not create downstream scientific claims.
